_meta.indication: Improvement in the appearance of moderate to severe convexity or fullness associated with submental fat in adults

pivotal_trials.design: Randomized, blinded, placebo-controlled; subjects treated in up to 6 treatment sessions at 28-day intervals, each session up to 50 injections (0.2 mL each) on a 1-cm grid
pivotal_trials.population: Adults aged 18 to 65 with scores of 2-3 (moderate to severe submental convexity) on the clinician- and patient-reported submental fat rating scales
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Co-primary endpoints: at least a 1-grade and at least a 2-grade improvement from screening to 12 weeks post-treatment on both the CR-SMFRS and the PR-SMFRS
pivotal_trials.result: 2-grade improvement: 13.4% deoxycholic acid vs <0.1% placebo; 1-grade improvement: 70.0% vs 18.6%; >=10% MRI volume reduction: 46.0% vs 5.3%

nct_ctgov.title: Phase 3 Study of Deoxycholic Acid Injection (ATX-101) Versus Placebo for the Reduction of Localized Subcutaneous Fat in the Submental Area

pivotal_trials.design: Identical to Study 22: randomized, blinded, placebo-controlled; up to 6 treatment sessions at 28-day intervals, up to 50 injections (0.2 mL each) on a 1-cm grid
pivotal_trials.population: Adults aged 18 to 65 with scores of 2-3 (moderate to severe submental convexity) on the clinician- and patient-reported submental fat rating scales
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Co-primary endpoints: at least a 1-grade and at least a 2-grade improvement from screening to 12 weeks post-treatment on both the CR-SMFRS and the PR-SMFRS
pivotal_trials.result: 2-grade improvement: 18.6% deoxycholic acid vs 3.0% placebo; 1-grade improvement: 66.5% vs 22.2%; >=10% MRI volume reduction: 40.5% vs 5.2%

nct_ctgov.title: Phase 3 Study of Deoxycholic Acid Injection (ATX-101) Versus Placebo for the Reduction of Localized Subcutaneous Fat in the Submental Area

key_safety: Adverse reactions predominantly local injection-site effects: injection site reactions 96% vs 81% placebo, edema/swelling 87% vs 43%, hematoma/bruising 72% vs 70%, pain 70% vs 32%, numbness 66% vs 6%. Serious risks: marginal mandibular nerve injury (4% of ATX-101 subjects) and dysphagia
target_moa: Cytolytic drug: when injected into tissue, deoxycholic acid physically destroys the cell membrane causing lysis of adipocytes
modality: Small molecule (synthesized bile acid, new molecular entity)

advisory_committee.vote: Dermatologic and Ophthalmologic Drugs Advisory Committee convened March 9, 2015; the committee unanimously agreed the available data support approval

summary.text: Standard NDA (505(b)) for an aesthetic indication; action memo dated April 3, 2015, approved first cycle on the basis of two placebo-controlled Phase 3 trials after a unanimously supportive Dermatologic and Ophthalmologic Drugs Advisory Committee, with one post-marketing required safety study in subjects 65-75 years of age

2897-1 A safety assessment of deoxycholic acid treatment in subjects aged 65 years and older. This assessment is to be performed in the ongoing ATX-101-13-28 trial population of subjects aged 65 to 75 years. To the extent possible, all subjects should be continued through the planned end of the trial (even if a full course of treatment is not administered).
